title: five arms and the four-on-the-floor spiral
story: Dua Lipa's Houdini opens with a sparse intro: five hits, one per bar from 71 to 317, each add an arm to a single-armed spiral with a flash, so the viewer learns the spiral. The groove from 335 is four on the floor at 117 bpm: the kick thickens the rings on every beat, the claps on 2 and 4 shake and lift the brightness, and the palette steps every two bars. The prominent hit at 448 punches the frame with shake and zoom, and the post-roll settles.
